profile.name: Agilent BioTek 多功能微孔板读板仪
profile.description: 这是一种台式微孔板读板仪，用于对微孔板中的样品进行吸光度、荧光和发光检测。设备通常带有载板抽屉、温度控制和振荡功能，适用于生化分析、细胞实验和高通量筛选等实验室检测工作。
profile.description_en: A benchtop multimode microplate reader used to measure absorbance, fluorescence, and luminescence from samples in microplates. It typically includes a plate tray, temperature control, and shaking, and is used for biochemical assays, cell-based experiments, and high-throughput screening.
